# MD. Sazzad Hossain Adib — AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer

> AI Engineer in Dhaka, Bangladesh, building production LLM systems and full-stack AI applications. AI Research Engineer at Robot Bulls, building a real-time Talking Head system for natural, face-to-face voice conversations with AI. B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering, North South University (CGPA 3.83/4.00, Merit Scholarship — top 1% of class).

## Case studies

- [AI Doctor Assistant](/case-study): Voice-powered medical consultation platform with AI-driven healthcare assistance.
- [DeshiPlate AI](/case-study/deshiplate-ai): Bangladeshi food recognition (33 dishes, 89.76% accuracy) with nutrition assistance.
- [InterviewBD](/case-study/interviewbd): Community-driven interview preparation platform.
- [Daily English Vocabulary](/case-study/english-learning-platform): AI-generated daily vocabulary tests with progress tracking.
- [SHOBDOTORI](/case-study/shobdotori): Regional-to-standard Bangla speech recognition.
- [Educational Chatbot](/case-study/educational-chatbot): Offline, SLM-based RAG chatbot for educational assistance.
- [Road Accident Analysis](/case-study/road-accident-analysis): ML system predicting patient status and injury severity.
- [Movie Reservation Website](/case-study/movie-reservation): Agile-driven full-stack app built by a 5-member team.
- [Viper Travel](/case-study/viper-travel): Travel booking platform with an SQL-based backend.

## Stack

Python, PyTorch, LLMs, RAG, LangChain, HuggingFace Transformers, TypeScript, Next.js, React.js, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Docker, Vercel.
